Accessibility statement

We aim to make this website usable with keyboards, screen readers, magnification and different devices, using WCAG 2.2 Level AA as our baseline.

Features

The site provides descriptive image text, labelled form controls, visible keyboard focus, a skip link, semantic headings and reduced-motion support. The optional game uses canvas, keyboard controls and text status updates. It may still present barriers for screen-reader users. No business service requires playing it.

Report a barrier

Use our contact page to share the affected page, the task and your browser or assistive technology if you wish. Automated checks alone do not establish full accessibility conformance.
